N1.s: તમારી %lld મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ ગઈ છે. કટલિંગમાં ચાલુ રાખો તો અનલૉક કરીને આ કટલિંગ પણ સાચવી શકશો.
N1.back: your 5 free place filled gone is. Cutling-in continue keep then unlock having-done this cutling also save will-be-able.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own 'મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ ગઈ છે'; 'ચાલુ રાખો' is the vocab's continue word, so the sentence names the button the system shows beside it, and the 'X તો Y' condition is how a speaker says continue and you can save it. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.

N2.s: તમારી %lld મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ ગઈ છે. વધુ સાચવવા કટલિંગ ખોલીને અનલૉક કરો.
N2.back: your 5 free place filled gone is. more to-save Cutling having-opened unlock do.
N2.why: Here the app cannot open itself, so the person is told to open it ('ખોલીને'); 'વધુ સાચવ-' repeats S2's title so the reply and the sheet they will see share their words. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.

N3.s: સચવાઈ ગયું, એક મફત જગ્યા બાકી
N3.back: got-saved gone, one free place remaining
N3.why: 'સચવાઈ ગયું' is the spoken 'it's saved', neuter like the vocab's 'થઈ ગયું', so no gender is guessed for કટલિંગ; 'બાકી' without છે is the clipped capsule form K1 uses. 29 characters. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.

N4.why: Same opening as N3 so the two capsules read as one voice; the used/total pair takes S29's '%1$lld/%2$lld' shape and 'ભરાઈ' is K1's word for full. Shows 'સચવાઈ ગયું, 5/5 મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ', 30 characters. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.

N5.s: %1$lld/%2$lld મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ, અનલૉક કરી આ સાચવો
N5.back: 5/5 free place filled, unlock having-done this save
N5.why: K1's 'મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ' with N4's pair; 'અનલૉક કરી આ સાચવો' (unlock and save this) tells the person the item in hand is waiting, without a tap instruction the bar's own look already gives. About 30 aksharas, inside 32. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.

N6.why: S15's button word, so the Share sheet and the unlock sheet say the same verb; 'X કરો' is how Gujarati iOS buttons are labelled ('રદ કરો'), and it renders narrower than 10 Latin letters. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.

N7.s: તમારી %lld મફત જગ્યા ભરાઈ ગઈ છે. કટલિંગ અનલૉક કરો તો આ પણ સચવાઈ જશે.
N7.back: your 5 free place filled gone is. Cutling unlock do then this also got-saved will-go.
N7.why: 'આ' points at the item shown in the form below, which avoids 'કટલિંગ' twice in one line meaning the app and the item; 'પણ' (this one too) says the item is not lost. Same in gu and gu-IN: Gujarati is written one way, and both folders' vocab files are identical.
